candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input once and emits one complete policy capsule. The final call consumes that capsule as its immediate read-only predecessor, directly receives only candidate_hypothesis, has no direct visibility into the other common inputs, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Counter-Aperture Executable Handoff
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one complete executable origin artifact and one counter-only terminal evidence aperture

calls.objective: Use the common evidence once to constitute one complete executable policy artifact that preserves governing obligations and counter-pressure for downstream settlement.

Consume originate_executable_carrier as a read-only, nonbinding complete predecessor, consider only candidate_hypothesis as late external evidence, preserve represented governing obligations, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.forbidden_inherited_mechanism: terminal lossless reacquisition of all six common external inputs
mode_certificate.independent_replacement_principle: Only candidate_hypothesis receives direct terminal re-exposure; every other source has one-time origin influence carried through a complete read-only executable predecessor.
rejected_assumptions: Sound terminal settlement requires symmetric reacquisition of every common source.
Anchor evidence and counter-evidence should retain equal late visibility.
A non-policy analysis is sufficient when most raw sources are withheld from terminal authority.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Apply a counter-only terminal aperture: all common inputs influence one complete executable origin artifact, while only candidate_hypothesis receives direct terminal re-exposure.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: Executable continuity remains visible while terminal behavior becomes less anchored to inherited rationale and more responsive to changed evidence regimes.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: Source-neutral terminal reacquisition lets inherited anchor evidence regain equal standing precisely when policy authority is exercised, allowing the counter-hypothesis to be absorbed by reconciliation.

structural_mutation.after: A complete executable policy capsule reaches a terminal authority that directly receives only candidate_hypothesis and treats the capsule as a read-only, nonbinding predecessor.
structural_mutation.before: A non-policy analysis reaches a terminal authority that reacquires all six common inputs with symmetric direct visibility.
structural_mutation.factor: counter-only terminal aperture on a complete executable carrier
structural_mutation.why_structural: One edge-aperture rule changes payload state, direct source visibility, and evidence timing without adding branches or separate settlement mechanisms.

validation.factor: counter-only terminal aperture on a complete executable carrier

policy_bearing_output_kinds.executor_semantics: complete policy artifact plus obligation evidence on the same single lineage
